info.name: Grace — PayPal Disputes
info.description:
Grace answers a merchant's PayPal disputes. This collection exercises the real `customer_disputes_v1` contract (spec 1.11, vendored in `openapi/`) plus Grace's own decision layer.

**Order matters.** Run 1 → 2 to get a token and a real dispute id from the sandbox, then 3 to see what Grace would file, then 4 to actually file it.

Set `environment` to `sandbox` or `live`. Sandbox is free and is what the hackathon rules require.

exec: // Every collection run ends by asserting the contract held.

request.description: Sandbox tokens are free. The token is written to a collection variable so the rest of the folder needs no auth configuration.

exec: pm.test('every reason code is one PayPal defines', () => {

query.description: From components/schemas/dispute_state: OPEN_INQUIRIES | REQUIRED_ACTION | REQUIRED_OTHER_PARTY_ACTION | UNDER_PAYPAL_REVIEW | APPEALABLE | RESOLVED

request.description: Only the cases waiting on the merchant. Query parameters are validated against the spec — an unknown filter is a client error, not a silent no-op.

Grace's own decision layer: map the reason to the evidence it demands, gather what exists, and recommend contest / contest partly / accept with coverage and reasons. This is the part PayPal's API does not do.

formdata.value: {"evidences":[{"evidence_type":"PROOF_OF_FULFILLMENT","evidence_info":{"tracking_info":[{"carrier_name":"FEDEX","tracking_number":"122533485"}]},"notes":"Shipped 2026-10-12, signed for at the delivery address."}]}
formdata.description: The exact shape from PayPal's provide-evidence documentation: a JSON `input` part plus file1..fileN.

request.description: Content-Type must be multipart/form-data. Only evidence_type values from the spec are accepted — PROOF_OF_FULFILLMENT carries tracking_info; PROOF_OF_REFUND carries refund_ids.

item.name: 5. PayPal — make offer (settle inside the window)

request.description: offer_type is an enum: REFUND | REFUND_WITH_RETURN | REFUND_WITH_REPLACEMENT | REPLACEMENT_WITHOUT_REFUND. Grace computes the ceiling — the highest amount cheaper than contesting.

item.name: 6. PayPal — accept claim (concede, avoid the fee)

request.description: The endpoint PayPal's own agent toolkit exposes — and the only dispute verb it exposes. In Grace this is the honest fallback whenever coverage is zero, not the only option.

item.name: 7. Grace — character of an account (the idea)

request.description: One identical payment judged against three businesses. Same amount, same vendor, three answers — because the history differs.

item.name: 8. Grace — contest the one the evidence supports

request.description: Returns the packet and statement that would be posted, or records an acceptance when the evidence is not there. It refuses to fabricate a contest.
